item.title: AgentPresso 0.1
item.description:
Initial public release of AgentPresso — an AI-native WordPress agent for macOS.

Key Features

  • Conversational AI agent for autonomous WordPress site management
  • Built-in skills: WP-CLI, admin browser, security, SEO, theme development, plugin management, database, content creation, Gutenberg blocks, REST API, WooCommerce
  • Multi-site management with Freemius license activation
  • Customizable settings: skills toggle, model selection, permissions, licensing, appearance
  • Sparkle auto-updates — always stay on the latest version

System Requirements

  • macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later
  • Apple Silicon or Intel Mac
